content.title: Upgrade to v4.0.0 (Cosmos SDK v0.47 -> v0.50)
content.description: Upgrades passage-2 from Cosmos SDK v0.47 to v0.50 (CometBFT v0.38.12, ibc-go v8.0.0, wasmd v0.50.x / wasmvm 1.5.x - no contract-state change). Enables x/circuit (circuit breaker), expedited governance, proposal cancellation, Sign Mode Textual, and AutoCLI. The upgrade handler sets: minimum validator commission 5%; expedited voting period 24h and expedited threshold 67%; governance quorum 50% and veto threshold 50% (SDK v0.50 shares quorum and veto between normal and expedited proposals); expedited minimum deposit 1,000,000 PASG. Includes a required iavl v1.2.2 empty-store patch - without it, v0.50 nodes fail to load the v0.47 database at the upgrade height. Real-state fork-tested: [PENDING fork-test - all module migrations apply, NN/NN wasm code hashes and NN/NN contracts preserved]. On-chain upgrade name: v4.0.0. Binaries and checksums in the v4.0.0 GitHub release.
